name: 59802 · Missoula, MT
findings: ZIP 59802 (Missoula) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59802 (Missoula) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 59802 (Missoula) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
